result.description: Northstar Harbor is a fictional 27-inch curved display built for general office and home entertainment use. It features a 2560x1440 panel, 144Hz refresh rate, adaptive sync support, built-in stereo speakers, and HDMI/DisplayPort inputs. The product is positioned as a monitor rather than a storage or graphics component.
result.title: Northstar Harbor 27-inch 144Hz Curved Monitor
